The Institute of Agriculture and Animal Science (IAAS, ) is one of the five technical institutes under Tribhuvan University, Nepal's largest academic institution.
IAAS runs undergraduate, postgraduate and Ph.D. programs in Agriculture and Livestock stream. it previously ran Diploma courses till 2012. The institute has four constituent and four affiliated campuses in the country.
History
IAAS was established in 1959 AD under Tribhuvan University as one of the technical institute at Rampur, Chitwan. Later constituent Campuses were established in Lamjung, Paklihawa and Jhapa respectively. Currently the central campus Rampur Campus is situated in Khairahani, Chitwan.
Constituent Campuses
Source:
* Rampur Agriculture Campus, Khairahani, Chitwan
* Lamjung Agriculture Campus, Sundarbazar, Lamjung
* Paklihawa Agriculture Campus, Paklihawa, Rupandehi
* Gauradaha Agriculture Campus, Gauradaha, Jhapa
Affiliated colleges
Source:
* Agriculture and Animal Science Community Campus, Gokuleshwor, Baitadi
* College of Live Sciences, Tulsipur, Dang
* Prithu Technical College, Lamahi, Dang
* Mahendra Ratna Multiple Campus, Ilam
Courses offered

* BSc Horticulture
* Bachelor of Veterinary Science and Animal Husbandary
